name: Programming and Data Structures
description: Python programming, problem solving, data structures, algorithms, debugging, testing, and engineering foundations for college learners.

skills.name: Python Syntax and Types
skills.description: Use Python values, variables, expressions, and core built-in types correctly.

skills.name: Python Control Flow
skills.description: Use conditions and loops to express bounded algorithms.

skills.name: Python Functions
skills.description: Design functions with clear inputs, outputs, scope, and responsibilities.

skills.name: Python Collections
skills.description: Choose and operate on lists, tuples, dictionaries, and sets.

skills.name: Python Object-Oriented Programming
skills.description: Model behavior with classes, composition, inheritance, and encapsulation.

skills.name: Python Exceptions and Modules
skills.description: Handle expected failures and organize reusable Python modules.

skills.name: Complexity Analysis
skills.description: Reason about time and space growth using asymptotic notation.

skills.name: Arrays and Strings
skills.description: Solve traversal, indexing, window, and transformation problems.

skills.name: Linked Lists
skills.description: Reason about nodes, references, insertion, deletion, and traversal.

skills.name: Stacks and Queues
skills.description: Apply LIFO/FIFO structures to parsing, traversal, and scheduling problems.

skills.name: Hash Maps
skills.description: Use key-based lookup, counting, grouping, and duplicate detection.

skills.name: Trees and Heaps
skills.description: Traverse trees and apply heap ordering to priority problems.

skills.name: Graphs
skills.description: Model relationships and use breadth/depth traversal safely.

skills.name: Recursion
skills.description: Define base cases, recursive progress, and stack behavior.

skills.name: Sorting and Searching
skills.description: Select and implement core search and ordering strategies.

skills.name: Greedy and Dynamic Programming
skills.description: Recognize optimization structure, subproblems, and valid greedy choices.
